name: Zynaps: systemvars
summary: The level order, the scenery coroutine, the wave launcher and the print variables.

labels.name: LevelOrder
labels.comment: The order of the 12 levels: 0 1 2, six of 3-8 shuffled, 9 10 11

labels.name: ExtraLifeScores
labels.comment: The scores of the extra lives: the score's +1 byte (BCD) 01 03 05 07 09, then $FF

labels.name: GlyphAlloc
labels.comment: The glyph allocator: the slot index, the bitmap byte's low address ($E0-$FF), the bit mask

labels.name: MainSP
labels.comment: The main stack pointer, saved while the scenery coroutine runs ($8D60, $8D69)

labels.name: ScriptSP
labels.comment: The scenery coroutine's stack pointer (its stack top $FDFB, StartScript $8D35)

labels.name: ScrollColumn
labels.comment: The map ring pointer of the leading column ($B760 at the level start; +1 per scroll step)

labels.name: ScriptColumn
labels.comment: The column where the next group goes, +16 per group (ResumeScript $8D45)

labels.name: ScriptRoom
labels.comment: The columns scrolled since the last group: +1 per scroll step, -16 per group

labels.name: ScriptBusy
labels.comment: $FF while a group is being placed, 0 after it

labels.name: ScriptVariant
labels.comment: The variant mask (high nibble) the group objects are tested with; $F0 on the tape

labels.name: ScrollMap
labels.comment: The scenery map position: cell = ScrollMap + 128 Y + X ($B730 at the level start; SceneryCell $99FF)

labels.name: DrawQueueRead
labels.comment: The sprite build queue's read index 0-7 ($ACAD)

labels.name: DrawQueueWrite
labels.comment: Its write index (QueueSpriteLoad $9441)

labels.name: DrawQueue
labels.comment: 8 entries of 3 bytes: the kind, the record address

labels.name: WaveTemplate
labels.comment: The 44-byte object record LaunchWave builds once a wave and copies to each enemy

labels.name: WaveTarget
labels.comment: +$29/+$2A the target, the player $F36C

labels.name: WavePaths
labels.comment: The path number of each enemy of the wave being launched ($9231-$9247)

labels.name: FreeEnemySlots
labels.comment: Free slots of the 8 enemy records at $F398 (5 at the level start)

labels.name: WavesAllowed
labels.comment: Wave records that may be in use (6 at the level start); LaunchWave -1, the wave's end +1

labels.name: EnemyShotsLeft
labels.comment: Enemy shots that may still start (3 at the level start; EnemyFire $A113)

labels.name: WaveRecords
labels.comment: 6 wave records of 3 bytes: the live count ($FF free, bit 7 one escaped), the bonus byte, the kind

labels.name: SpriteCacheMask
labels.comment: A bit per used sprite cache record ($93A7)

labels.name: SpriteCacheFree
labels.comment: The free record of a use mask: low nibble, or the high one by bit 4 of the kind ($93D8)

labels.name: BigSpriteMap1
labels.comment: A 7 x 9 cell map (one bit a cell) for BuildBigSprite with A = 1

labels.name: BigSpriteMap2
labels.comment: The cell map for BuildBigSprite with A <> 1

labels.name: PrintPos
labels.comment: The print position, an attribute address $5800-$5AFF (PrintChar $A33B, print codes 3-6)

labels.name: PrintAttr
labels.comment: The printed characters' attribute (print codes 0-2)

labels.name: PrintPending
labels.comment: Below $20: a print code waiting for its byte; $20 none (PrintChar $A326)

labels.name: RasterTable
labels.comment: The colour table of the menu raster interrupt ($A520): $FC20

labels.name: RasterLines
labels.comment: The scan lines the menu raster colours: 168 or 112

labels.name: RasterList
labels.comment: The colour list ExpandNextColours takes ($A5B0)

labels.name: RasterSpare
labels.comment: Six bytes no routine reads or writes in c1/c2

labels.name: RasterFrames
labels.comment: Frames the menu raster still runs (-1 a frame, $A578)

labels.name: LaserShotsFree
labels.comment: Laser shots not in flight (4 at most, $B2D1); fire when it plus the laser level is 4 or more

labels.name: LaserHitMask
labels.comment: Per pass: the enemy bits hit by the ship or a laser (TestHitGrid $9150)

labels.name: ColourCycle
labels.comment: 8, $10, $18: +8 each pass ($AA1B); the pods' flashing colour

labels.name: HarmlessMaskA
labels.comment: Enemy bits that do not kill the ship nor stop a laser (StartExplosion, ExplosionToPod)

labels.name: HarmlessMaskB
labels.comment: See HarmlessMaskA

labels.name: ShipHistoryIndex
labels.comment: The index into ShipHistory (PlayerHandler $9AF3)

labels.name: ShipHistory
labels.comment: The ship's last 8 positions, 4 bytes each (X fraction, X, Y fraction, Y); the sight follows the oldest

labels.name: LockTarget
labels.comment: The enemy record the sight locked on ($9FFC)

labels.name: LockMask
labels.comment: Its collision bit, 0 no lock

labels.name: MissileHitMask
labels.comment: Per pass: the enemies the homing missile hits (cleared by RunObjects $94B2)

labels.name: SightMask
labels.comment: Per pass: the enemies under the sight

labels.name: PlasmaHitMask
labels.comment: Per pass: the enemies the plasma or the seeker hit

labels.name: Fuel
labels.comment: The fuel / power timer: -1 on passes with PassBit bit 0, $B4 from a full pod cycle, halved when a pod is lost

labels.name: WeaponRatingMask
labels.comment: $FF or $30 (WeaponRating $9B75); EnemyFire $A0F6 reads it

labels.name: WeaponRatingValue
labels.comment: How fast the next waves fly (WeaponRating $9B75: + ScriptLevelBias); EnemyFire $A109

labels.name: WeaponRatingLevel
labels.comment: 0 or 8: picks the KindColours set (LaunchWave $9271)
